areaCopy: LA Glass serves customers throughout the Los Angeles area. Share your project city or ZIP code when requesting a quote so the team can confirm availability.
ctaCopy: Share the project type, location, and a few details. LA Glass will review the information and follow up about the next step.
expectCopy: A few things that make any glass project go smoothly.

expectPoints.copy: Tile, stone, and paint should be complete before final measuring. Glass is cut to the finished surface, so measuring beforehand risks a fit that no longer matches the room.
expectPoints.title: Finish your surfaces first

expectPoints.copy: Which way a shower door opens affects splash, clearance, and how the room feels. It is worth deciding early rather than at installation.
expectPoints.title: Think about how the door should swing

expectPoints.copy: Finishes seen across recent LA Glass projects include matte black, chrome, brushed nickel, and brushed brass. Matching existing fixtures in the room usually reads best.
expectPoints.title: Pick your hardware finish

expectPoints.copy: Glass panels are heavy and awkward to carry. A clear path from the door to the room makes the install faster and safer.
expectPoints.title: Clear access on installation day

featuredCopy: A selection of real LA Glass projects — no staging, no stock photography.
heroBody: LA Glass creates and installs custom shower enclosures, shower doors, glass railings, mirrors, storefronts, and architectural glass throughout the Los Angeles area. Free estimates, Monday – Saturday.
processCopy: Four steps, and you always know which one you are in.
processHeading: From first message to finished installation

processSteps.copy: Send basic project information, approximate dimensions when available, your location, and helpful photos. Photos of the full room are more useful than close-ups — they show how the glass meets the walls, floor, and any fixtures.
processSteps.title: Share your project

processSteps.copy: LA Glass reviews the details and follows up for anything needed to prepare your free estimate. If something about the space changes the approach, you hear about it now rather than on installation day.
processSteps.title: Review and estimate

processSteps.copy: Precise field measurements and project details are confirmed before fabrication or installation. Walls are rarely perfectly plumb, which is exactly why measuring on site matters more than measuring off a drawing.
processSteps.title: Measure and plan

processSteps.copy: The glass and hardware are installed according to the approved project scope, with the work area left clean.
processSteps.title: Install

servicesCopy: LA Glass provides custom glass installation for residential and approved commercial projects across the Los Angeles area — built around precise measurements, clean installation, and dependable hardware.
servicesHeading: Glass work, measured and fitted to your space
socialCopy: Fresh installations go up on Instagram and TikTok.
whyCopy: Custom glass is unforgiving of shortcuts. A panel cut a few millimetres wrong does not sit right, and no amount of hardware hides it. These are the standards behind every installation.
